text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — OpalQuay onboarding health: noticed 95th pct latency jumps on >1024 token requests and cost per convo is ~2.3x forecast. Renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks, want to proactively reduce unit cost and smooth tail latency. Proposing: short canary for int8 quantization + model swap for generation on long-context routes, plus routing split (fast small-model for short prompts, 13B compact for long). Thoughts?

alex_se: +1. Recommend: int8 for most gen traffic, keep fp16 for high-quality routes. For long-context, consider a locality-aware routing rule: if tokens>512 -> route to compact-13b with kv-cache enabled; else route to tiny-6b for bursty UI completions.

ben_sre: Data: last 24h 95p latency = 1.9s -> 3.8s on long jobs. GPU utilization spikes at 92% during peak. Int8 should cut token time ~18-28% depending on kernel sets; KV cache + prefix caching could shave additional 12% for repeated convo turns. Need to scope memory for int8 kernels (some extra workspace).

alex_se: Plan for canary: create a route /v1/opalquay/gen with two variants. Canary config snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: opal-gen-canary
    match: request.tokens > 512
    variants:
      - model: rwd-compact-13b-int8
        weight: 20
      - model: rwd-legacy-13b-fp16
        weight: 80
    fallback: rwd-legacy-13b-fp16
```
Run for 48-72h, track latency, cost, and rl-based quality metric.

maria_cs: Good. Need to capture customer-perceived quality — can we run eval set A (top 50 real prompts) through both models and collect BLEU/ROUGE + manual pass/fail? Also schedule enablement call with their SRE and PM next Tues.

dina_pm: Renewal flag: Customer mentioned cost in last convo. If canary shows >15% cost savings with <2% drop in eval pass-rate, we should surface a dedicated-capacity upsell or long-term quantized reserved pool to lock in savings and SLA.

ben_sre: Ops checklist:
- spin canary pool (2x A100-small int8)
- enable prefix KV cache for conv sessions >1 turn
- route telemetry: token_latency_ms, model_choice, cost_estimate_per_call
- add alert for error-rate >1% during canary

ben_sre: Quick deploy command (devtools):
```bash
# create canary profile
rictl routes apply --file opal-canary.yml --env prod --dry-run=false
# monitor logs
rictl logs tail --service opal-gen-canary --since 1h
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for opal-gen-canary at 2024-08-16T14:03:12Z (jobs queued: 2). :rocket:

maria_cs: Capture feedback loop: I'll send them the eval packet and a short qual form (3 questions: 1) perceived latency change, 2) quality regression? 3) accept cost-quality trade?). We'll keep a channel-level thread open and update daily.

alex_se: If we see quality regressions for safety/LLM-instruction cases, we can pin a fallback rule on generation where prompts containing "policy" or "agreement" always use fp16 variant. Example match: `contains(prompt, "policy") OR contains(prompt, "legal")`.

maria_cs: OK action items: 1) ben - spin canary + enable kv cache (today), 2) alex - prepare eval run + routing yaml (today), 3) maria - send eval packet + schedule Tues enablement (tomorrow), 4) dina - prep renewal upsell language if canary meets thresholds. I'll post daily status here. :white_check_mark:

ben_sre: On it. Will post canary metrics snapshot in this thread once the first 1000 calls complete.

alex_se: I'll wire up the logging to include per-route cost tags so we can show exact $/k tokens for each variant.

maria_cs: Thanks team — let's aim to have initial numbers by EOD tomorrow.
